shortDescription: Manage an SSL Orchestrator TAP security device

options.name: devices
options.description: Specifies the network attachment for the TAP security device.

options.name: dump_json
options.description: Sets the module to output a JSON blob for further consumption. When C(true), does not make any changes on the device and always returns C(changed=False). The output provided is idempotent in nature, meaning if there are no changes to be made during C(MODIFY) on an existing service, no JSON output is generated.

options.name: mac_address
options.description: Specifies the MAC address to use for the TAP service clone pool (static ARP).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the TAP security service. The configuration auto-prepends "ssloS_" to the service. The service name should be less than 14 characters and not contain dashes "-".

options.name: port_remap
options.description: Specifies the port number to remap to for traffic to this TAP service.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for the C(CREATE) or C(MODIFY) task to complete. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.

options.name: vendor_info
options.description: Specifies the vendor-specific TAP service used. The default is C(Generic TAP Service).
